Definition: Average gross domestic product per person in current USD
Expectation: Countries with larger GDP per capita have more records on GBIF

Definition: Total gross domestic product in current USD
Expectation: Countries with larger total GDP have more records on GBIF

Definition: Research and development expenditure as percentage of GDP
Expectation: Countries investing more in R&D have more records on GBIF

Definition: Number of full-time equivalent researchers per million inhabitants
Expectation: Countries with more researchers produce more biodiversity records

Definition: Official development assistance specifically allocated to biodiversity projects in USD
Expectation: Countries receiving more biodiversity aid have more records on GBIF

Definition: Composite index measuring standard of living and life expectancy
Expectation: Countries with higher HDI have more records on GBIF

Definition: The most widely spoken language in the country
Expectation: Language affects the number of records a country has on GBIF

Definition: Whether English is the primary official or most spoken language
Expectation: Countries with English as main language have more records on GBIF due to scientific communication

Source: Pew Research Center / CIA World Factbook
Definition: The religion practiced by the majority of the population
Expectation: Religion affects the number of records a country has on GBIF

Definition: Percentage of population identifying as atheist or non-religious
Expectation: Countries with higher rates of non-religiosity have more records due to scientific culture correlation

Definition: Whether country was a colonizer colonized or neither and by/from which country
Expectation: Former colonizing countries have more records; colonized countries have historical collection bias

Definition: Measure of government openness and data accessibility
Expectation: Countries with higher open knowledge scores have more records on GBIF

Definition: Political system classification (democracy authoritarian hybrid etc.)
Expectation: Democratic governments have more records on GBIF due to open science culture

Definition: Number of distinct ecoregions present within a country's borders
Expectation: Countries with more diverse biomes have more records on GBIF

Definition: Percentage of land area designated as protected (converted to %)
Expectation: Countries with more protected areas have more records due to monitoring efforts

Source: FAO Global Forest Resources / World Bank
Definition: Percentage of land area covered by forests
Expectation: Countries with higher forest cover have more records especially for forest-dependent taxa

Definition: Absolute value of the latitude of the country's geographic center
Expectation: Countries closer to equator (lower latitude) have more records due to higher biodiversity

Definition: Number of species found exclusively in that country
Expectation: Countries with more endemic species attract more research interest and have more records

Definition: Total population of the country
Expectation: Countries with larger populations have more potential observers and more records on GBIF

Definition: Total land area of the country in square kilometers
Expectation: Larger countries have more diverse habitats and more records on GBIF

Definition: Number of people per square kilometer of land area
Expectation: Higher population density correlates with observer availability up to a threshold

Definition: Percentage of population living in urban areas
Expectation: More urbanized countries have more records due to citizen science app usage

Definition: Primary climate classification (tropical arid temperate continental polar)
Expectation: Temperate zone countries have historically contributed more records due to observation infrastructure
